_meta.description: Crosstab with no column grouper — rows are the signup years of subscribers.pulse, the one column is the implicit Total — whose cell is AGG_AVERAGE of the churned flag, read as 0/1 (each signup year's churn share), decorated with OVERLAY_PROP_Z_VS_PRIOR: a pooled two-proportion z-test of each year's share against the year before it, the survey tracker's wave-on-wave significance test. The share is the cell value and n its components' n, so normalize must stay none. The first year has no prior: a null statistic and no p-value; the second year carries the z (negative when the share fell) and its two-sided p. The test assumes the two years are independent samples of subscribers. Buffered: reads Response.Components.Crosstab.
_meta.name: crosstab-prop-z-vs-prior
